features.notes: Previous real IME evidence covers one Windows/IME/runtime combination. Hidden explicit-text paste now preserves completed Hangul, decomposed jamo and emoji exactly at pre-ConPTY and ReadConsoleW boundaries. This is not new OS clipboard or real IME acceptance. Native caption painting now normalizes only a temporary drawing copy with Win32 NormalizationC, leaving raw model/HWND/input/path/persisted codepoints untouched. Memory-only font/Uniscribe probes did not improve decomposed Hangul, while the normalized drawing copy matched NFC/NFD pixels; hidden native rendering confirms equal NFC/NFD pixels with raw model/HWND captions preserved. Physical IME remains unverified.
One Windows/IME/runtime combination verified; full review acceptance remains open.

Interactive move trial was contaminated by concurrent user desktop input. Redundant native focus is avoided in code, but real IME validation of that change remains pending. User requested background-only work.

Windows-only built-in Windows PowerShell/CMD/PowerShell 7 discovery, default and per-tab/workspace executable/argv, split inheritance and persisted per-surface shells implemented. Hidden hosts verify real PowerShell/CMD, exact Unicode cwd/argv, relative CLI cwd, mixed-shell restart, old state and explicit failed-start recovery. PATH/PATHEXT executable ordering has native file tests. Actual PS7 (unavailable locally), other interactive shells, command-language parsing, aliases, UNC/long paths and physical menus/IME remain pending.

Configurable terminal scrollback 0–100000 lines applies to live xterm views and persists across Windows hosts. Hidden native test reduces it to 100, emits 600 lines, verifies old history eviction and retained new output. Native scrollbar/selection/IME, memory/load and complete scrollback parity remain pending.

Exact 128 KiB UTF-8 selection snapshots survive TUI redraw/erase, hidden or moved tabs and process exit; explicit clear/search/input/buffer transitions discard them. CLI selection read/all/range/clear waits for parsing without clipboard access or target activation. Clipboard shortcuts and a terminal context menu are implemented with focus/visibility/composition cancellation and no retry. Ten hidden WebView2/ConPTY selection checks and mocked frontend clipboard/menu tests pass. Real OS clipboard, physical drag/double-click/column selection, shortcuts/menu, IME/DPI/accessibility, large-selection memory and all race acceptance remain pending.

CLI paste waits for prior PTY output parsing and uses xterm current bracketed-paste mode. Hidden native tests verify mode on/off, multiline Unicode, empty no-op, 128 KiB boundary and inactive-surface routing at both input boundaries. Literal controls remain literal; this is not sanitization. Desktop clipboard, all timeout/close/queue races, shell/TUI interoperability and broad IME acceptance remain pending.

Native hidden WebView2/ConPTY verifies retained Korean next/previous/wrap, case/regex, invalid-expression recovery, NFD/emoji selected text, soft-wrap crossing, hidden/moved/exited surfaces and normal/alternate separation. Real same-cursor overwrite reproduced stale addon cache; parser-complete invalidation fixes that case. Synthetic composition guards are not real IME evidence. Search-field IME, buttons/focus/DPI, complex expression latency and PCRE2 differences remain open.

Native hidden Windows host searches parsed retained output across inactive tabs/workspaces with literal/case matching, 500-line pages, native result list and two-stage activation. Korean/NFD/emoji, 260+ physical-row soft wraps, append/move preservation, rewrite/reflow/eviction refusal, alternate isolation and cancellation verified. Native mouse/keyboard/IME, visual layout/DPI, sustained-output/load and SSH integration remain pending. Changed-during-scan terminals are reported unavailable; each page rescans current output. The new owned 760x520 modal dialog has four passing hidden native groups for owner lifetime, original Unicode query/row captions, 500-to-700 bounded UI results, selection, empty/error state and close. Double-click activation, body preview font and physical IME/keyboard/DPI remain differences.

read-screen and capture-pane share parser-barrier viewport reads with stable surface targeting, bounded exact text and buffer/range metadata. Hidden native WebView2/ConPTY checks cover Unicode, soft wraps, overwrite/CR/erase, retained selection/scroll position, hidden and moved tabs, alternate isolation and process exit. 128 KiB limits, error recovery and split-byte barriers are covered by frontend/Rust tests. Native oversized-grid/timeout/close races, sustained load, broader TUI/Unicode/reflow and full capture compatibility remain pending; tmux capture flags are not implemented.

--recent reads at most 80 latest normal-buffer physical rows independently of viewport/cursor, or the full alternate screen including footer rows. On-demand extraction avoids copying full history on every output. Ten hidden native screen checks include these ranges and inactive parsing. Agent status polling/classification is not wired yet; sustained-load budgets, rate limiting and broader TUI/Unicode acceptance remain pending.

Cell-based canvas minimap reads bounded normal-buffer rows via public xterm APIs, including wide Hangul, truecolor, ANSI palette, inverse/dim/invisible and backgrounds. Preview wheel and terminal seek are separate; keyboard navigation, parser-barrier CLI and hidden-tab raster suspension are implemented. Nine hidden native checks verify actual canvas checksums, colors/cells, scroll changes, selection preservation, history clearing and moved/exited surfaces. Physical pointer/keyboard/IME/accessibility, sustained multi-pane load and OSC palette mutation remain pending.

Shared persisted minimap settings default to enabled/40 CSS pixels/50 percent; width 12..96 and opacity 0..100 apply live. Alternate mode hides painting but retains gutter and ConPTY columns, verified in a hidden native host. Disabled minimaps release raster/gutter and reset preview. Rendering caps preview to 2048 rows and raster scale to 2x; high-DPI/multimonitor/visual/menu and active-composition acceptance remain pending.

Hidden Windows restart preserves Korean and green SGR normal-buffer history across fresh ConPTY startup, including inactive tabs; bounded to complete rows within 128 KiB. Alternate screen, broader style/Unicode/wrap fidelity and restoration IME remain pending.

PowerShell prompt integration and CMD child-only PROMPT reports preserve local Unicode cwd, tab/split inheritance and persisted cwd. Explicit CLI/launcher relative cwd is resolved at invocation; raw IPC relative cwd uses its source terminal. Hidden native probes verify Korean/NFD/emoji/ampersand paths. CMD uses /D; raw custom executable selections do not add prompt integration. Other shells, AutoRun/prompt frameworks, UNC/device/remote paths, long paths and interactive IME remain open.

The existing pure Rust OSC extractor/parser/store are reused read-only. Hidden native ConPTY delivers ST-terminated OSC 9/99/777 with exact Korean, NFD jamo and emoji; numeric OSC 9 cwd/progress metadata is excluded. Output byte/time observations are exposed without agent classification. BEL transport, other ConPTY/OS/shell combinations, Kitty multipart features, notify-stream/pty-tee and hook integration remain pending.

Native Options and CLI implement shared font/fallback list, 6–72px size, dark/light terminal theme and cursor blink/style. Hidden native hosts verify exact Unicode values, actual xterm options/colors and ConPTY grid with stable shell PIDs. Native chrome light/dark rendering now has hidden production-renderer evidence in a two-terminal split with stable terminal identities/PIDs. A later mixed terminal/browser/editor render is separate visual evidence. Real menu/IME/DPI, high contrast, installed font fallback/width, custom themes, remaining popup/panel styling and configurable zoom shortcuts remain pending. The new owned nonmodal Options window groups General/Theme settings; text fields use Apply and combo changes are immediate. Five hidden Options checks pass in 5.285s, including Unicode values, live terminal ACK, validation errors/draft retention and Reset/Close with stable terminal identity. Full theme editing, Keybindings/Update and physical interaction remain open.

Named keys use parser-barrier cursor-mode snapshots and stable surface targeting. 128 pinned-xterm reference vectors are checked in normal/application modes against pre-ConPTY and ReadConsoleW bytes. Guards cover composition/settling/restore and bounded pending input; no synthetic desktop input is used. Physical repeat, actual focus reporting/IME transitions, advanced protocols, all timeout/close races and broader shell/TUI acceptance remain pending.

Hidden hosts and native tests verify natural exit/final output, process-tree ownership, 100 tab cycles, invalid executable and missing restored executable, saveable failed terminals and explicit same-surface CMD retry. Native startup suppresses system error dialogs and restores thread error mode; failed unwinding closes undrained output before ConPTY. Physical recovery button, thread-start fault injection, hung child startup, WebView/GPU failure and broader lifecycle acceptance remain pending.

Native menus, UTF-16 name/color editor and CLI workspace operations implemented. Earlier hidden native hosts verify Unicode/ampersand captions, title locks, 41 reorders with stable identities/processes, hidden caller context, targeted multi-terminal/descendant close and metadata/history restart. The preceding chrome stage verified name/current-cwd two-line captions, Unicode cwd and rename/color updates with stable HWNDs/PIDs, rounded/color styling, and five-workspace overflow with four visible rows, active first/last visibility and pager endpoints. Final workspace remains protected; empty-window UI, drag reorder, automatic name reset, broader status metadata, real menu/dialog/IME/DPI/high-contrast/accessibility remain pending. The sidebar now supports per-window preferred width 160–640 DIP (default 260), temporary clamping to reserve 320 DIP of main area, drag cancellation and preserving preference on no-movement clicks. Footer icons/header bell and overflow-only pager placement are implemented; current actual-host drag/layout/restore checks remain pending.

Nested divider geometry and native drag handlers implemented. Hidden Windows verification checks CLI ratios, native WebView bounds, real ConPTY sizes, invalid request invariance, inactive workspace isolation and restart persistence. Actual divider drag, very small windows, DPI and composition during resize remain pending under background-only constraint.

Hidden native hosts verify tab moves/reorder with stable process, surface, output, cwd and calling-surface routing; user-locked Unicode tab names survive shell title output and restart without activation. New hidden chrome checks verify focused-pane tab accents. Terminal/browser/editor glyphs were visually inspected in a separate mixed-surface capture; per-pixel icon identity is not asserted. Native rename dialog constructs hidden and preserves UTF-16 values, but actual menu/dialog IME and keyboard remain pending. Drag/drop, automatic title reset, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain.

Directional focus and temporary maximize/restore implemented with CLI, native button and guarded fixed shortcuts. Hidden Windows verification checks hidden Korean output, 40 zoom transitions with size convergence, stable processes, structural transitions and restart restoring normal layout. New production native renders verify focused-pane selected-tab accents. Physical keyboard/button/focus, real IME, DPI/high-contrast rendering and accessibility remain pending.

Hidden Windows host verifies same-window moves/reorder with stable process, surface, viewport output, cwd and calling-surface CLI routing. Native menu and IME move rerun pending; rename, drag/drop, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain.

Owned in-window overview implements real workspace/pane cards, active state, live Unicode name/order updates, clipped scrolling, exact-HWND select/dismiss/close and existing dirty/final-workspace guards. Hidden native workflow and editor-close checks passed. Capture is limited to ready visible tabs; inactive workspace thumbnails are unavailable. A captured hidden terminal raster showed background/cursor without verified glyphs; capture success is not full visual acceptance. Terminal Ctrl+Alt+K only; physical focus/IME/DPI/accessibility and complete Linux visual parity remain pending. A separate browser case verifies 33,714 source-color pixels in the native overview card and unchanged DOM focus/scroll/PIDs. A later mixed capture includes terminal text, but preview freshness and complete glyph preservation remain unverified.

Native workspace/tab context menus and modeless UTF-16 metadata editor implemented. A hidden native Rust test constructs the editor and preserves Unicode values/error text without showing or focusing its HWND. Physical menus, dialogs, IME, DPI/accessibility, popovers and drag previews remain pending. A header notification bell and 36-DIP Settings/Files/Search/Open file icon row now retain native captions and tooltips. The earlier sidebar stage has hidden layout/tooltip evidence. Current structural changes add a nonmodal General/Theme Options window, a 320-DIP owned bell popup, one workbench-right Files dock with conditional forms, and 40-DIP browser toolbar/tools. Hidden native groups pass for Options (5), notifications (9), global Files dock (2), browser geometry/lifecycle (8) and file-operation regression (5). Full popup/dialog/drag-preview and physical interaction acceptance remain open.

Native Options now contains a searchable Keybindings page using the existing shared 37 ActionIds/defaults without modifying shared code. Twenty-eight terminal-input actions support rebind/unbind/default/reset, seven have no configurable Windows terminal binding, and Copy/Paste remain fixed. Writes validate normalized collisions/reserved chords and compare the whole override map under the settings lock. General Reset preserves valid bindings; the page has separate Reset. Settings ACK includes the entire resolved table and revision; host dispatch requires that exact current revision and an active visible ready terminal. Eight hidden native groups verify real native controls, Unicode draft retention and controlled IME guards, CAS, actual renderer-handler rebind/unbind/new-tab dispatch and guard suppression; Options regression nine groups, Windows unit 32 and Node 62 tests pass. The renderer hook is not physical OS keyboard/IME/TSF evidence. Browser/editor/native-control routing, full editor priority, Linux-equivalent binding presentation, physical focus/IME/DPI/accessibility and all 37 actions remain incomplete.

Existing xterm views apply shared terminal settings without shell recreation or requested focus; composition/history restore defers to the latest value. Hidden native tests verify multiple active/inactive tabs, another window, external edits and restart. Native chrome theme changes now have production-renderer evidence with stable terminal identities/PIDs in a two-terminal split. Mixed terminal/browser/editor rendering is captured separately; theme transitions across mixed types and control-handle preservation during theme changes are not established. Mock composition deferral is not real IME evidence. Native menus, real composition/focus/DPI/high-contrast, per-tab options and full settings parity remain pending. The new General/Theme Options window reuses asynchronous field updates and expected-value validation. Its native edit/Apply, theme selection, error draft retention and Reset/Close pass within the five-check 5.285s hidden case. Text fields require Apply, unlike Linux immediate editing; Keybindings/Update and full theme/settings parity remain pending. Options now autosaves supported edits (250 ms debounce for text, immediate selections), with native scrolling groups and per-field CAS. Nine hidden GUI groups verify actual persistent settings and terminal ACKs, raw Unicode drafts, burst edits, application IME-message guards, external changes and close/reopen. Physical OS IME/TSF/focus and complete Linux options/theme/font-picker parity remain unverified or incomplete.

Hidden Windows hosts preserve workspace/pane/surface identity, layout, focus, titles, local cwd, styled normal history and each terminal executable/argv in fresh processes. Default settings reload independently. Old state retains Windows PowerShell despite a changed default; missing executables leave a recoverable terminal. Window geometry, live-process recovery, agent resumption, wider style/Unicode fidelity and interactive IME remain pending.

Independent new windows launched from native terminals survive source-tab close, clean source-window quit, forced source-host exit and a further CMD launch. Caller cwd/PATH/Unicode environment and new CLI routing IDs are retained correctly through a bounded broker request. Ordinary terminal descendants retain strict job ownership. Shared settings/state leases have prior isolated evidence, but full multiwindow state, concurrency, existing-tab detachment and external-job policy coverage remain pending.

Native Notifications button/list, unread workspace/tab captions, CLI list/read/delete/clear/jump and stable source routing are implemented. Hidden controls and source lifecycle are verified. Output counters are observations only; activity/usage panels, panel switching and real input/accessibility remain pending. The bell now opens a 320-DIP owned popup with newest-first bounded rows and Open/Delete/All Clear. Its presentation snapshot retains unread styling before store acknowledgement. Nine current hidden popup/source-routing groups pass; physical activation/focus remains unverified; activity/usage and full panel switching remain unavailable.

Native WebView2 browser tabs reuse the shared right-sibling placement model and support explicit down splits. Hidden loopback verification covers source terminal identity, mixed pane moves and browser-only restore. Physical UI/IME, broader placement/lifecycle and cross-window acceptance remain pending.

Native address/Go, history, reload/stop, 0.5–3.0 zoom and loading/error status implemented. Native navigation IDs guard old completions. Hidden fixture verifies Unicode DOM/address text, back/forward, reload, redirect, stop recovery and network errors. Actual address IME/keyboard/button interaction, visual rendering/DPI/accessibility and HTTP/TLS breadth remain pending. Current browser chrome is a 40-DIP single row with address, navigation, reload/stop, Go and tools; narrow-pane navigation uses the tools menu. Eight hidden native browser groups pass, including stable Reload/Stop bounds, compact/narrow/restored toolbar geometry and navigation/lifecycle; physical input remains unverified.

Top-document non-mutating DOM snapshots use shared headless Rust types and per-surface refs with window-wide unique tokens. Hidden WebView2 evidence covers Unicode grapheme excerpts, unique selectors, stale ref rejection after DOM/navigation/tab changes, moves and size bounds. Frame/shadow traversal, full accessibility semantics and complete pending-request races remain pending.

DOM click/dblclick/hover/scroll and focus/blur commands implemented with current-ref validation, per-surface admission and no automatic replay. Hidden live tests cover synthetic pointer events, scroll, stale DOM/tab/navigation refs and pending status. Focus/blur are intentionally refused in background test hosts; real focus, CSS hover, physical hit testing/selection, IME and exhaustive races remain pending.

Ref-based fill/select/check/uncheck implemented using native DOM setters and synthetic events. Hidden tests cover ordinal Unicode, newline/value rules, beforeinput cancellation/replacement/disable, readonly/file rejection, option precedence/multiple select and checkbox/radio idempotence. Active-element type/press, contenteditable/custom widgets, broad framework behavior and physical IME remain pending.

Synchronous eval, URL/title/status and read-only text/value/attr/count/is-visible/is-enabled/is-checked queries implemented. Hidden fixture verifies ordinal Unicode preservation, plain/JSON results, property/CSSOM reads, stale refs and output bounds. Asynchronous eval, broader accessibility state semantics, all pending-request races and complete automation parity remain pending.

Selector/text/URL/ready-state/synchronous JS waits implemented with surface pinning, one in-flight callback, native navigation epochs, deadline checks and bounded transport extension. Hidden fixture covers exact Unicode, delayed/streaming pages, timeout, runtime errors without replay, late callbacks, redirects, tab hiding/close, concurrent capacity and waits beyond default IPC deadlines. Prompt client-disconnect cancellation, transient states between polls, broader frame/shadow semantics and exhaustive races remain pending.

Native WebView2 viewport PNG capture implemented with CLI-relative Unicode paths, surface/navigation/viewport guards, size bounds, two pending slots and off-thread atomic save. Hidden fixture decodes actual pixels and covers scroll/zoom, active tabs, locked overwrite, invalid paths, loading rejection, concurrent capacity and viewport-change recovery. Physical DPI/minimized/multi-monitor behavior, remote filesystems, callback-loss/close/disconnect/timeout races and real IME remain pending.

Browser URL and surface identity persist separately from terminal histories/shells. A separate persistent WebView2 browser profile retains localStorage across a hidden browser-only restart. Private/nonpersistent mode, profile selection/management, bookmarks, cookies/login/session breadth and full acceptance remain pending.

Hidden native WebView2 downloads preserve UTF-8 filename* codepoints and payload bytes; staging/no-replace publication handles collisions, cancellation and native retries. Eight active transfers, ninth rejection, hidden list/remove/clear and source/host closure have live evidence. Destination UI, pause/resume, persistence, physical UI/DPI/accessibility, MOTW/security checks and exhaustive races remain pending. The current browser toolbar exposes Downloads through Browser tools; existing transfer semantics are unchanged. Single-row native geometry passes; physical tools-menu navigation remains unverified.

Page find now uses the actual engine with next/previous, case/wrap options, a native panel and CLI; eight hidden groups cover Unicode transport, owned selection cleanup, queued dismissal, surface pinning, navigation and closure. Native matching equivalence may differ from query codepoints. Popup routing now attaches a never-navigated child in the opener's actual WebView2 environment through SetNewWindow, creating an active tab in the original source pane. Live/pending bounds are 16/8; stale, hidden, closed and invalid-URL requests are rejected. Native close removes the exact browser and replaces a workspace's final browser with a fresh-ID blank view. Fourteen hidden popup groups passed in 45.107 seconds, including opener/Unicode/routing/close/capacity behavior; the ordinary-browser close case records the engine's outcome. Release builds, 141 actual Windows unit tests, 49 related native regression groups and installer packaging passed; results and remaining limits are tracked in the popup record. Full Find API parity, counts/highlight-all/regex, shadow/text-control selection cleanup, exhaustive popup races and cross-origin/named-target policies, physical IME/UI/DPI/accessibility, DevTools and site-permission UI remain pending. The current browser toolbar exposes Find in page through Browser tools. This entrypoint change adds no new Find/DevTools/permissions capabilities; toolbar geometry passes while physical tools-menu navigation remains unverified.

Hidden native WebView2 tests read and edit actual offline Monaco models, verify language IDs and undo/redo, and retain the existing WebView/document/undo history after a pane move. Physical editing, selection, syntax appearance, minimap, fonts, clipboard, IME, DPI and accessibility remain unverified.

CLI Open, duplicate identity, Save, explicit-overwrite Save As and shared UI/CLI serial Save All have hidden native evidence, including ten dirty Unicode documents. Open preparation now runs off the UI thread with pinned source/root and bounded admission. Initial overlapping real-client Open and background picker refusal passed; final-source expired queued Open creates no editor and permits a following Open. Sidebar Open File/editor pick are implemented, but physical dialog selection/cancellation/focus/IME and physical Save All controls remain unverified. WebView2 COM creation remains UI-bound. Source boundaries and failed attempts are preserved in editor-open.md.

Hidden real Monaco/file round trips preserve UTF-8, BOM, LF/CRLF and exact Hangul/NFD/emoji codepoints. Empty and single-line models remain LF internally while disk EOL metadata is retained. Physical text input, clipboard, glyph/width rendering, other encodings and exhaustive file-format cases remain pending.

Historical evidence covers explicit disk checks and conflict actions. Eight final-debug-source hidden native automatic-refresh cases now pass (58.397s summed runners): clean/inactive updates, dirty conflict, delete/recreate, same-size restored-timestamp writes, partial sharing-denied reads, move/close ownership and write-burst/own-save handling. Actual Monaco reads follow apply acknowledgment without check-disk. Partial errors retain advanced clean models and blocked models/errors; disk_status_known=false can remain sticky after unlock or an empty retry. Move/close testing waits for idle and observes bounded post-close absence, without forcing a queued-callback race. Busy close/model commands fail without replay; tab moves retain editor/view identity. Composition and known Monaco/HTML dialog deferral are implemented, with physical IME/UI unverified. No watcher restart, periodic fallback or explicit watched-root rename detection exists; noisy roots cause full scans. Concurrent-writer races and complete failure coverage remain pending.

Earlier hidden cases cover dirty-close guards, multiple-document restore and acknowledged-edit recovery. Seven final-source editor cases now include deep-path Restore, expired queued Open, accepted close during paused preparation, direct/editor late quit, dirty close and failed-checkpoint unsealing. Controlled lifetime checks suspend only exact owned hidden threads and record balanced resume/clean exit. Two earlier Restore failures are preserved. Unsynchronized edit-debounce/close races, all in-flight checkpoint timings, renderer crashes, power loss and physical confirmation/IME remain unverified.

Windows-only implementation adds Quick Open without a document snapshot, bounded workspace search over acknowledged open buffers and disk, retained-result source/version validation, and literal Monaco find/replace CLI with required replacement document/version. Workspace search supports Rust regex; NFC/NFD are preserved and ranges use shared zero-based UTF-16 positions, while Monaco CLI ranges are one-based. Two fixed workers admit eight requests, with four-second budgets, 16 MiB snapshots (32 MiB admitted), 2 MiB files, 64 MiB reads, 20000 entries, 2000 paths/500 matches and 1 MiB results. Skipped-file errors and truncation remain visible; cancellation does not release a running worker permit early. Six distinct hidden native cases passed across eight executions: the first five covered find (4.625s), replace (5.164s), Quick Open (4.679s), workspace search (5.195s) and retained-result Open (7.371s); deadline-corrected result Open (5.990s) and a real IPC deadline case (20.321s) followed. After a later Win32 path-separator correction, nested Unicode result Open passed (6.265s). Ten related editor checks passed on the initial source; earlier runs retain their recorded source boundaries. Result-open deadlines include IPC/UI queue time, reject expired work before submission and omit expired reveals while preserving already submitted model changes. The deadline case verifies unchanged model/selection after an owned hidden UI-thread pause and a successful fresh open; it does not force later worker timeout or flush/capture cancellation. All 208 Windows unit tests (13.135s), final Clippy (22.328s) and debug build (82.702s) passed after the separator correction. The earlier unit failure and stopped release build are preserved; release/package/cleanup results are separately tracked in evidence/2026-09-28/editor-search.md; these checks do not complete F06 acceptance. Physical UI/IME/clipboard/accessibility and broad filesystem-race coverage remain unverified.

Native Windows Files child panel implements bounded local tree expansion/collapse, path-based multiple selection, another 500 rendered rows, explicit refresh and retained-row editor Open. Seven distinct hidden native cases pass: nested Unicode >300 UTF-16-unit roots with new/reused Monaco documents, 1105-row paging, selection, refresh/stale tokens, reparse confinement, source-pane ownership/show-hide, and actual queued IPC expiry preserving prior state. One worker/eight admitted requests retain permits through response consumption; four-second original deadlines, 20k entries/four-MiB path cache, 64 expansion/depth, one-MiB status pages and 32-pane/16-MiB host cache are bounded. Listing acceptance is tracked here; single-file mutations are tracked under F08. Physical keyboard/mouse/IME/focus, glyphs/DPI/accessibility, all limits and hostile filesystem races, automatic tree watching and persisted tree restoration remain unverified or unsupported. See source boundaries and preserved failed verification attempts in the evidence. The current UI uses one visible 320-DIP dock at the right of the whole workbench, retaining source-pane caches and editor routing. A 58-DIP header/path and Actions/context menus restore tree space; two hidden dock/source-switch/native-form groups pass. Historical Files cases do not establish this new layout.

Single-file local Copy/Rename/Move use retained Files tokens, one host-wide worker, accepted operation IDs and 64 terminal receipts. Existing destinations and open editor sources (clean or dirty) are rejected; Copy preserves raw bytes up to 16 MiB. Five affected hidden native cases pass: long nested Unicode roundtrip with actual LISTBOX/Monaco, BOM/CRLF and binary NUL copy, invalid destinations, editor guards and stale tokens. Preparation pins handles; NtCreateFile/NtSetInformationFile avoid path re-traversal for mutation. Cancellation/deadlines are cooperative and close/editor operations reject while active. Related regressions and final builds/package are tracked separately in the evidence. Clipboard cut/paste, batch/directory/remote/reparse/case-sensitive paths, overwrite and physical keyboard/IME/focus acceptance remain unsupported or unverified. Current UI routes the existing single-file operations through Actions/context menus and a conditional destination form. Two hidden groups verify the form/dock flow and five file-operation regression groups pass; existing operation scope and guards are unchanged.

features.notes: Hidden native evidence covers Unicode paths, root-boundary rejection, explicit overwrite, denied replacement preserving old bytes and isolated recovery storage. Recovery uses a protected-DACL temporary writer. A 266-UTF-16-unit checkpoint temporary-path failure led to extended-length parent paths; final deep-path Restore and the Windows long-checkpoint unit test pass, with the failure retained. Full ACL/ownership preservation, concurrent writers, UNC/network/reparse paths, power-loss durability and exhaustive long-path behavior remain pending.

An in-memory per-window 50-entry log reuses the existing eight-second source dedup and severity escalation. Hidden native tests verify Unicode detail/captions, unread state, current workspace/pane after moves, preserved exited screens and atomic closed-source rejection. Desktop toast delivery/activation, OS taskbar badges, preferences, real foreground suppression/focus and native mouse/keyboard interaction remain pending. The current bell UI changes to an anchored 320-DIP owned popup, with unread snapshot-before-ack and row/clear actions; nine hidden native groups pass; physical activation/focus remains unverified. Desktop toast/taskbar and real input acceptance remain open.

features.notes: Installed console flowmux.com, GUI flowmux.exe and command-only flowmuxctl.exe share parsing/client paths. Leading shell/equals launch flags, CMD/PowerShell resolution and waiting, stdout/stderr, JSON runtime errors, Unicode/empty/quoted argv, two-window targeting, file/NUL redirection and closed stdout verified with hidden native processes. GUI launch explicitly forbids handle inheritance after a reproduced redirected-EOF hang. The JSON launch receipt establishes process creation only. Full legacy command parity, altered PATHEXT/custom shells, clean install/update and interactive desktop coverage remain pending. Native terminal launch now delegates through its originating verified pipe to the GUI host. Both launchers preserve caller UTF-16 argv/cwd/environment, remove stale terminal routing context and reject stale endpoints/surfaces without fallback or replay. Hidden checks verify independent new-window lifetime; broker uses its own GUI build. External job restrictions and timeouts after dispatch remain separate boundaries.

Abandoned-client recovery, atomic discovery and OS-reported pipe PID validation remain verified. IPC now uses 16 reusable overlapped pipes/workers, at most 16 outstanding GUI command permits, whole-frame deadlines, bounded peer-close waits and coordinated cancellation/join before terminal teardown. Native tests cover fragmented Unicode, oversized frames, pending accept/read/write/GUI cancellation, instance reuse, command permit lifetime and repeated pool handle release. Live hidden tests verify 16-of-24 idle admission, idle expiry, CLI reply timeout, unread quit shutdown, multiwindow routing, 640 disconnects and persistence regressions. Commands are not retransmitted after dispatch; a timed-out command may still execute later. The earlier workspace restart failure remains unexplained. Partial startup fault injection, fatal-pool recovery, crash-record cleanup, sustained load/fairness, complete discovery/multi-user/deployment acceptance remain pending.

Stable calling-surface routing survives moves and inactive tabs; identify/tree expose current local cwd, and same-line child CLI context updates cwd before the next prompt. Full context/capability parity, remote environments and cross-window cases remain pending.

Hidden Windows host verifies same-window moves/reorder with stable process, surface, viewport output, cwd and calling-surface CLI routing. Native menu and IME move rerun pending; rename, drag/drop, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain. capture-pane aliases the parser-barrier viewport read; --recent and read-only range metadata are available. Full command parity remains pending. Named keys now use parsed cursor mode and explicit inactive/moved surface targets.
